description: Conversion and compilation retain cached per-file native handles across module reads, accumulating open streams.
trigger: Conversion/compilation traverses enough source or per-module qtensors files for cached handles to exhaust the available stream limit.
expected_behavior: Release handles after module data has been loaded while preserving tensors and reusable collection metadata.
actual_behavior: Cached handles remain open across module boundaries until collection closure; compilation reads all per-module qtensors files through one collection. Actual stream limit and failing-job handle count were not measured.

introductions.rationale: 128 reviewer traced per-file caching to the root; five native handles per file initially.

observations.source: Approved fix explanation and reviewer source investigation.

fixes.rationale: Closes module.config.stc after module loading and qtensors_stc after each module read; normal path only.

verification.description: 128 approved draft inspects cached reopening, tensors retained in memory and the two added close calls; reviewer traces caching to root and five-to-eight handles at119.
verification.limits: No conversion or handle-count measurement; no claim of a particular limit or confirmed successful rerun.

affected_revisions.limits: Root caching and119 increase identified by reviewer; no continuous affected range or measured failure threshold. Fix128 only addresses normal-path retention.
